column1: Story rail tile [11474-226918]
column5: PROMOTED: THE LAST OPEN AXIS IS MEASURED AND SHIPPED. Waves 27, 28 and 35 all closed the tile's geometry at delta 0 and all three left the RING COLOUR open, calling it two accents whose seen/unseen mapping the boards would not say. Read in full 2026-09-08 - every tile of all three rails, 21 of them - and the premise was wrong twice over. There are THREE accents, and the accent follows the HANDLE, identically on every board: @CryptosTraderX #17F9B4 (10430:98335 / 11474:227177 / 11474:226926), @CryptoWhizKid #FF7E50 (10430:98340 / 11474:227172 / 11474:226921), @BlockchainGuru #FF7E50 (10430:98345 / 11474:227182 / 11474:226931), @TokenMasterX #56C7F3 (10430:98350 / 11474:227187 / 11474:226936), @DigiCoinExpert #56C7F3, @AltcoinAdventurer #FF7E50. A viewer's reading state cannot differ per board and these do not, so it is not a viewer state at all and there was never a coin toss to lose - the question was the wrong shape. THE LIVE DEFECT THAT CLOSES WITH IT: the ring painted `border-primary` #2DEDAD when unseen and `border-border` #123F3C when seen, and NO tile of any rail draws either; since no caller sets `seen`, every ring in the running app was #2DEDAD. Fixed in acc761ad1 - `entry.accent` strokes the ring, falling back to a stable pick over the three so a rail always draws the palette the boards draw, and `seen` stays on the entry unwired because no board draws a seen treatment. GEOMETRY RE-CONFIRMED at the same time, delta 0: tile 72/78/91, ring 64/72/82, ring-to-caption 6, caption 72/78/90 at 12/14 then 12/16, arrow 36 on a #123F3C hairline at (rail-36)/2 = 24/29/34, rail gap 20 at 1440 and 18 at 768 with the arrow the last child of one flow. ORACLE StoryRail.figma.test.tsx, 5 new cases, 4 mutations all RED. THE ONE THING THIS ROW DOES NOT CLAIM is that a user sees a rail: SocialFeed passes stories=[] and StoryRail then draws nothing, which is deliberate and is a PAGE gap tracked on 5100-183573, 11442-164397 and 11442-164766 - not the tile's.

column1: Skai > Social - with "tweets" > comment thread (1440 x 900px) [9657-215247]
column5: STAYS done, AND ONE VALUE INSIDE IT WAS WRONG UNTIL TODAY. Re-read 2026-09-08 on all three boards - 9657:215844 (1440), 11474:226522 (768), 11474:226650 (375). `Frame 465` IS the comment list and it declares VERTICAL itemSpacing 16 on every board, each closing on its own children at that gap: 226 + 16 + 50 + 16 + 50 = 358 at 375, and 248 + 16 + 56 + 16 + 56 = 392 at 768 and 1440. The card shipped `space-y-3` = 12, from a reading that took `Frame 355` for the list and `Frame 465` for the distance to the composer. Neither holds: `Frame 355` is a sub-group holding the first TWO of the four comments at 12 - the only 12 in the modal, and named in the test so it is not re-read as the rule - and the composer block `Frame 1217` is a SIBLING of the list under `modal`, whose itemSpacing is 24, the gap-6 the card already carries. Fixed in 1bc32b619, mutation RED. `Frame 1216` re-read at the same time and matching: x=40 from the parent row's left edge, width 460, itemSpacing 16 at all three, against `ml-6 border-l pl-[15px]` and `mt-4 space-y-4`.
